title: DrugHarness: An Evolvable Agent Harness for Computational Drug Discovery

paragraphs.en: Computational drug discovery requires agents to compose scientific operations and adapt to changing evidence and constraints. Here we introduce DrugHarness, an evolvable agent harness coupling composable scientific execution with conditional skill induction. Its environment integrates over 80 scientific operations, biomedical resources and task-specific code, preserving associations among candidates, results and artifacts. From execution trajectories and outcome feedback, DrugHarness induces action hypotheses with observable applicability conditions, recommended actions and supporting evidence. An independent review agent evaluates candidate skills derived from these hypotheses through source verification and, when needed, targeted execution trials. Admitted skills guide subsequent tasks and are revised through feedback. Evaluation on MolBench and SMDD-Bench demonstrates capabilities in molecular screening, optimization and constrained design. Without evolution, DrugHarness exceeds reported MolClaw-CC results by 10.8 percentage points in affinity-comparison accuracy and 55% in mean top-three active hits on MolBench. Retrospective evaluation on skill-development tasks shows that evolution increases Qwen’s affinity-comparison accuracy from 62.2% to 81.1% and optimization success from 79.5% to 87.2%. In a prospective HPK1 study, DrugHarness achieves a more favorable median docking score than Biomni among system-specific candidates. A synthesized compound achieves a cellular IC50 of 14.19 nM, a 2.64-fold potency improvement over the best input reference, with activity competitive with two selected compounds designed by experienced medicinal chemists. These results support conditional skill evolution for scientific agents and demonstrate a workflow connecting computational drug design with experimental validation.
paragraphs.zh: 计算药物发现需要智能体组合科学操作，并适应不断变化的证据和约束条件。 在此，我们介绍 DrugHarness——一种可进化的智能体框架，它将可组合的科学执行与条件技能诱导相结合。 其环境集成了超过 80 项科学操作、生物医学资源及任务特定代码，同时保留了候选物、结果与产物之间的关联。 通过执行轨迹和结果反馈，DrugHarness 能够推导出具有可观察适用条件的行动假设，包括推荐行动和支撑证据。 一个独立的评审智能体通过来源验证以及必要时开展的针对性执行试验，评估这些假设所衍生的候选技能。 被采纳的技能将指导后续任务，并通过反馈进行修订。 在 MolBench 和 SMDD-Bench 上的评估表明，该框架在分子筛选、优化和约束设计方面展现出强大能力。 即使没有进化机制，DrugHarness 在亲和力比较准确性上仍比已报道的 MolClaw-CC 结果高出 10.8 个百分点，在 MolBench 的平均前三活性化合物命中率上高出 55%。 对技能开发任务的回顾性评估显示，进化机制将 Qwen 的亲和力比较准确性从 62.2% 提升至 81.1%，优化成功率从 79.5% 提升至 87.2%。 在一项前瞻性 HPK1 研究中，DrugHarness 在特定系统候选物中获得了优于 Biomni 的中位对接分数。 一种合成化合物实现了 14.19 nM 的细胞 IC50 值，比最佳输入参考化合物效力提升了 2.64 倍，其活性可与两名经验丰富的药物化学家设计的两种化合物相媲美。 这些结果支持了科学智能体的条件技能进化方法，并展示了一种连接计算药物设计与实验验证的工作流程。

paragraphs.en: Drug discovery requires coordinating evidence and computation across molecular screening, optimization, and design. Experimental activity records, molecular representations, and property or binding predictors provide complementary information for candidate selection ( Liu et al., 2025 ; RDKit contributors, ; Swanson et al., 2024 ; Passaro et al., 2025 ) . Turning these capabilities into a solution requires a sequence of decisions: which evidence to retrieve, which candidates to modify, which calculations to perform, and when a set of molecules satisfies the objective. Recent agent systems have begun to automate these multi-step tasks, making the organization of scientific actions and the reuse of effective strategies central questions for autonomous drug discovery ( Averly et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 药物发现需要协调分子筛选、优化和设计各环节中的证据与计算。 实验活性记录、分子表示以及性质或结合预测模型为候选物选择提供了互补信息（Liu 等，2025；RDKit 贡献者；Swanson 等，2024；Passaro 等，2025）。 要将这些能力转化为实际解决方案，需要一系列决策：获取哪些证据、修改哪些候选物、执行哪些计算，以及何时认为一组分子满足目标。 近期的智能体系统已开始自动化这些多步骤任务，使得科学行动的组织和有效策略的重用成为自主药物发现的核心问题（Averly 等，2025；Wang 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Progress spans three connected directions. Tool and environment integration makes scientific resources accessible through specialized interfaces, code-based composition, and reusable infrastructure ( Bran et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2025b ) . Workflow orchestration organizes these operations through domain skills, specialist collaboration, and stateful processes that maintain intermediate results and guide subsequent actions ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Gao et al., 2025a ; Cao et al., 2026 ) . Experience and skill reuse brings earlier solutions back into execution: prior designs inform new molecular proposals, historical tool trajectories guide lead optimization, and accumulated scientific experience supports later reasoning and tool selection ( Gao et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2026 ; Tang et al., 2025 ; Tang et al., 2026b ) . Together, these directions establish a basis for agents that both execute scientific workflows and accumulate guidance from their use.
paragraphs.zh: 进展涵盖三个相互关联的方向。 工具与环境的一体化使科学资源可通过专用接口、基于代码的组合以及可重用的基础设施加以获取（Bran 等，2024；Huang 等，2026；Gao 等，2025b）。 工作流编排通过领域技能、专家协作以及能够保留中间结果并引导后续操作的状态化流程来组织这些操作（Zhang 等，2026b；Gao 等，2025a；Cao 等，2026）。 经验与技能的复用将早期解决方案重新引入执行过程：先前的设计为新分子提案提供依据，历史工具的发展路径指导先导化合物优化，而积累的科学经验则支持后续推理和工具选择（Gao 等，2025a；Li 等，2026；Tang 等，2025；Tang 等，2026b）。 这些方向共同为基础，使得智能体既能执行科学工作流，又能从使用过程中积累指导信息。

paragraphs.en: Despite this progress, turning heterogeneous scientific experience into dependable action guidance presents three coupled challenges. (1) Grounding a recommendation in the right evidence. An activity measurement, a predicted property, an agent’s interpretation, and a final task score answer different questions; their objects, endpoints, and observation times determine which action claims they support. (2) Preserving applicability across tasks. A useful source-task action may become inappropriate when the candidate state or remaining constraints change. For example, a set with adequate molecular properties but insufficient diversity may benefit from broader structural exploration rather than further optimization of similar candidates. (3) Establishing executable and revisable guidance. A plausible recommendation may rest on an unchecked scientific premise or an operation that behaves differently from its description. Its critical assumptions and execution path need active examination, and subsequent task feedback must inform revisions as new evidence becomes available. These challenges call for a learning process that connects scientific evidence, observable conditions, and active scientific review to the continuing use of a skill.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展，但将异质的科学经验转化为可靠的行动指导仍面临三个相互关联的挑战。 （1）基于正确的证据提出建议。 活动测量、预测属性、智能体的解释以及最终的任务得分各自回答了不同的问题；它们所针对的对象、终点和观察时间决定了它们支持哪些行动主张。 （2）保持跨任务的可适用性。 一个在源任务中有效的行动，在候选状态或剩余约束条件发生变化时可能变得不再合适。 例如，一组具有足够分子属性但多样性不足的数据集，可能需要更广泛的结构探索，而不是进一步优化类似的候选体。 （3）建立可执行且可修订的指导方案。 一个看似合理的建议可能基于未经验证的科学前提，或依赖于一个实际行为与其描述不同的操作。 其关键假设和执行路径需要主动审查，并且随着新证据的出现，后续任务反馈必须用于指导修订。 这些挑战要求一种学习过程，将科学证据、可观察条件和主动的科学审查与技能的持续使用联系起来。

paragraphs.en: We introduce DrugHarness , a unified system for composable scientific execution and conditional skill learning. Its scientific environment provides over 80 scientific operations across ten capability categories, connecting tools, biomedical resources, and code while retaining associations among candidates, results, and artifacts. To ground reusable guidance, the learner compares these experiences and forms action hypotheses with explicit sources and applicability conditions. It translates each hypothesis into a skill whose conditions the executor assesses against the new task’s visible state. An independent review agent examines evidence, applicability, and executability, using the same scientific tools and code environment for targeted checks when needed. Admitted skills become available to subsequent tasks, whose trajectories and native outcome feedback support further revision. Review records also allow rejected or deferred proposals to inform later changes. This design connects scientific judgment with the formation, use, and revision of action strategies.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 DrugHarness，一个用于可组合科学执行和条件技能学习的统一系统。 其科学环境提供超过 80 项科学操作，涵盖十个能力类别，连接工具、生物医学资源和代码，同时保留候选项、结果和产物之间的关联。 为了为可重用的指导提供依据，学习者会对比这些经验，并形成具有明确来源和适用条件的行动假设。 它将每个假设转化为一个技能，执行者会根据新任务的可见状态评估该技能的适用条件。 一个独立的审查智能体负责检查证据、适用性和可执行性，并在必要时使用相同的科学工具和代码环境进行针对性核查。 被采纳的技能可供后续任务使用，而这些任务的执行轨迹和本土结果反馈支持进一步的修订。 审查记录也使得被拒绝或推迟的方案能够为后续的调整提供借鉴。 这种设计将科学判断与行动策略的形成、使用和修订紧密结合起来。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate DrugHarness on two benchmarks and a prospective molecular design study. On MolBench, DrugHarness without evolution achieves 91.9% affinity-comparison accuracy and 1.24 mean Hits@3, exceeding the reported MolClaw-CC results by 10.8 percentage points and 55%, respectively. On SMDD-Bench, it satisfies all evaluation criteria in 24 of 40 lead-optimization tasks and supports structurally constrained design (Tables 1 and 2 ). In retrospective evaluation on skill-development tasks, frozen learned skills increase Qwen’s affinity-comparison accuracy from 62.2% to 81.1% and optimization success from 79.5% to 87.2% relative to historical runs without skills (Table 3 ). In prospective HPK1 design, DrugHarness achieves a more favorable median docking score than Biomni among system-specific candidates (Figure 2 ). A synthesized compound achieves a Jurkat p-SLP76 IC 50 of 14.19 nM, a 2.64-fold potency improvement over the best input reference, with activity competitive with two selected compounds independently designed by experienced medicinal chemists (Section 4.4 ). These results demonstrate scientific execution capabilities, in-domain benefits from skill evolution, and experimentally validated molecular design.

paragraphs.en: Scientific agents organize capabilities through tool augmentation, code-based execution, and reusable environments, as illustrated by ChemCrow, Biomni, and ToolUniverse ( Bran et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2025b ) . SciToolAgent further represents tool dependencies and compatibility in a knowledge graph for tool-chain planning ( Ding et al., 2025 ) . Drug-discovery workflows use hierarchical domain skills, specialist collaboration, or stateful skill graphs to coordinate research stages ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Gao et al., 2025a ; Cao et al., 2026 ) ; CAi and LIDDiA organize candidate evidence and feedback-driven molecular exploration ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Averly et al., 2025 ) . Experience already participates in these workflows: PharmAgents summarizes earlier designs, and TRACE retrieves optimization trajectories to guide tool sequencing ( Gao et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 科学智能体通过工具增强、基于代码的执行和可重复使用的环境来组织能力，如 ChemCrow、Biomni 和 ToolUniverse 所示（Bran 等，2024；Huang 等，2026；Gao 等，2025b）。 SciToolAgent 进一步在知识图中表示工具依赖关系和兼容性，以实现工具链规划（Ding 等，2025）。 药物发现工作流程使用分层领域技能、专家协作或状态感知技能图来协调研究阶段（Zhang 等，2026b；Gao 等，2025a；Cao 等，2026）；CAi 和 LIDDiA 则组织候选证据并开展反馈驱动的分子探索（Wang 等，2026；Averly 等，2025）。 经验已经参与这些工作流程：PharmAgents 会总结早期设计，而 TRACE 则会检索优化轨迹以指导工具排序（Gao 等，2025a；Li 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: In the shared scientific workspace, the agent selects and combines these operations according to the task’s goals, constraints, and intermediate results. DrugHarness preserves associations among scientific objects, computational conditions, sources, and outputs across tool calls and task-specific code. As a result, evaluations from different tools remain linked to the same candidate, and returned structures or datasets can become inputs to further analysis. The runtime maintains the action loop as the agent uses this evidence to select further computations, revise candidates, and produce a final deliverable. Trajectories, deliverables, and permitted outcome feedback then provide material for skill learning.
paragraphs.zh: 在共享的科学工作空间中，智能体会根据任务的目标、约束和中间结果来选择并组合这些操作。 DrugHarness 会在工具调用和特定任务的代码中保持科学对象、计算条件、来源和输出之间的关联。 因此，来自不同工具的评估会持续与同一个候选项相关联，而返回的结构或数据集也可以成为进一步分析的输入。 运行时会在智能体利用这些证据选择后续计算、修订候选项并生成最终成果的过程中维持动作循环。 随后，轨迹、成果以及允许的反馈结果将提供技能学习所需的材料。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate three aspects of DrugHarness: scientific execution without learned skills, execution with experience-derived skills, and prospective evaluation of designed molecules. Model and runtime comparisons support the execution analysis, while task trajectories clarify how learned guidance enters scientific decisions. Appendix D presents four case studies of scientific execution, feedback use, and skill refinement.

paragraphs.en: DrugHarness (w/o Evol.) uses the full scientific environment without cross-task learned skills; its main configuration is Codex ( OpenAI, 2026 ) with GPT-5.6 Terra/xhigh. Model comparisons use Codex with Qwen3.7-Max, and runtime comparisons use Hermes ( Nous Research, 2026 ) with Terra/xhigh. Both comparisons cover all 190 MolBench tasks; runtime comparisons additionally cover 202 SMDD Types 1–5 tasks. We also evaluate the original SMDD harness with Terra/xhigh on the same SMDD task set. DrugHarness (Evol.) uses admitted, frozen skills: Qwen3.8-Max/xhigh performs automatic refinement and independent review. paragraphs.en: We use the two benchmarks for complementary purposes. SMDD-Bench evaluates DrugHarness on diverse constrained molecular-design problems and serves as a broad test of scientific execution ( Han et al., 2026 ) . MolBench provides a fine-grained decomposition of molecular decision-making and operations, spanning property filtering, similarity filtering, affinity comparison, virtual screening, molecular editing, and optimization, together with task-specific quantitative feedback ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) . We therefore use MolBench as the primary testbed for studying experience-driven evolution, where such fine-grained feedback enables systematic analysis of skill induction, use, and revision. SMDD-Bench uses task success rates; we evaluate a fixed 40-task lead-optimization (LO) subset spanning 25 targets and the complete remaining families. MolBench metrics include accuracy, mean active hits among the top three candidates (Hits@3), and positive-improvement success rate. Task breakdowns and metric definitions appear in Appendix A . The prospective HPK1 task evaluates analog design under collaborator-provided references and constraints (Section 4.4 ).

paragraphs.en: We use Codex with GPT-5.6 Terra as the main configuration to evaluate scientific execution without evolution. On SMDD-Bench, DrugHarness/Codex achieves 28.0% success in interaction point discovery versus 0.0% for the original SMDD harness, and 60.0% versus 50.0% on the same 40 lead-optimization tasks, with both systems using GPT-5.6 Terra (Table 1 ). On MolBench, affinity accuracy reaches 91.9%, 10.8 percentage points above MolClaw-CC, and mean Hits@3 reaches 1.24 versus 0.80. Screening accuracy is 98.0%, all 39 editing tasks are solved, and 37 of 39 optimization tasks yield positive improvement (94.9%; Table 2 ). Together, these results establish support for candidate judgments, precise molecular operations, and designs with joint structural and property constraints.

paragraphs.en: We vary the model within Codex to assess backbone dependence, and compare Hermes with Codex under Terra to assess runtime effects. With Qwen3.7-Max, DrugHarness attains 62.2% affinity accuracy versus 54.1% for both CAi and MolClaw, and 60.0% Hit@3 versus 40.0% and 52.0%, respectively; screening (96.0%) and editing (97.4%) match CAi ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Codex/Terra achieves the strongest overall performance among the DrugHarness configurations tested.

paragraphs.en: We design human HPK1 (MAP4K1) inhibitors from four experimentally characterized references, aiming to improve Jurkat p-SLP76 inhibition over the best reference (IC50: 37.47 nM). paragraphs.en: DrugHarness provides a mechanism for evolving scientific agent strategies through conditional skill learning. It turns execution experience into reusable guidance with explicit applicability conditions, independent scientific review, and feedback-driven revision. Evaluation on two benchmarks demonstrates broad molecular task capabilities, while retrospective results on skill-development tasks show improvements in screening, affinity comparison, and optimization. A prospective design study further links computational predictions to experimental activity, yielding a synthesized compound with improved cellular potency over all input references and activity competitive with selected expert-designed compounds. These findings support evidence-reviewed skill evolution as a promising approach to improving scientific agents and motivate broader evaluation of its generalization and experimental utility.
paragraphs.zh: DrugHarness 提供了一种通过条件技能学习来演化科学智能体策略的机制。 它将执行经验转化为可重复使用的指导，具备明确的可适用性条件、独立的科学审查以及反馈驱动的修订。 在两项基准测试上的评估展现了其在分子任务方面的广泛能力，而技能发展任务的回顾性结果则显示，筛选、亲和力比较和优化方面均有提升。 一项前瞻性设计研究进一步将计算预测与实验活性联系起来，最终合成出一种细胞效力优于所有输入参考化合物，且活性可与部分专家设计的化合物相媲美的化合物。 这些发现支持了基于证据审查的技能演化作为提升科学智能体的一种有前景的方法，并推动了对其泛化能力和实验实用性的更广泛评估。

paragraphs.en: 2D pharmacophore identification. The input comprises a protein sequence and ten active and ten inactive molecules. paragraphs.en: Interaction point discovery. Given a receptor and pocket specification, the agent submits three typed three-dimensional points. Type-compatible points are matched one-to-one to reference interaction sites using a distance criterion of less than 2.5 2.5 Å. Partial credit equals the number of matched points divided by three; success requires all three matches.
paragraphs.zh: 相互作用点发现。 给定受体和口袋规格，智能体提交三个带类型的三维点。 类型兼容的点通过距离小于 2.5 Å 的标准与参考相互作用位点一一对应匹配。 部分得分等于匹配点的数量除以三；成功需要全部三个点都匹配成功。

paragraphs.en: Lead optimization. The agent modifies a reference molecule while satisfying task-specific improvement targets, hold-constant intervals, and hard constraints. Property directions and tolerances belong to individual task specifications.
paragraphs.zh: 先导优化。 智能体在满足任务特定的改进目标、保持恒定区间和硬性约束的同时，对参考分子进行修改。 评估会同时检查分子的合理性、骨架相似性、属性要求以及预测的结合条件。 参考相似性阈值至少为 0.7 0.7。 属性方向和容差属于各个任务的具体规范。

paragraphs.en: LO subset selection. DrugHarness uses a fixed subset of 40 LO tasks spanning 25 targets, with one or two tasks per target. Six previously selected tasks and a designated DHODH task were retained. Additional tasks were selected to cover optimization directions, objective counts, and structural input sizes using public task inputs, with natural task identifiers breaking ties. The subset contains 9/9/9/8/5 tasks with one/two/three/four/five objectives, respectively. Structure sizes comprise 10/18/12 tasks with at most 200, 201–500, and more than 500 ATOM-record residues.
paragraphs.zh: LO 子集选择。 DrugHarness 使用一个包含 40 个 LO 任务的固定子集，涵盖 25 个靶点，每个靶点对应一或两个任务。 先前已选择的六个任务以及一个指定的 DHODH 任务被保留下来。 通过公开任务输入，选择了更多任务以覆盖优化方向、目标数量和结构输入大小；若出现平局，则以任务的自然标识符作为决胜依据。 该子集分别包含 9/9/9/8/5 个具有一个/两个/三个/四个/五个目标的任务。 结构大小包括 10/18/12 个任务，其残基的 ATOM 记录数最多分别为 200、201–500 和超过 500。

paragraphs.en: Fragment assembly. One or two spatially placed fragments must be retained within a valid output molecule. paragraphs.en: Given a reference molecule and protein–ligand complex, the BACE1 task requires decreases of at least 0.1 from the supplied baselines in four predictions: blood–brain barrier penetration (BBB), cytochrome P450 3A4 (CYP3A4) inhibition, hERG potassium-channel blockade, and Ames mutagenicity (AMES). Candidates must also meet four property-holding conditions and physicochemical, structural and binding constraints. The task specifies these optimization directions and requires one candidate SMILES satisfying the joint requirements.

paragraphs.en: DrugHarness generated molecules with Python/RDKit, registered them as shared candidate objects, and obtained ADMET-AI predictions. The first two batches contained 22 structures including the reference. Figure 4 compares the reference with B2-09 and B3-02. Second-batch candidate B2-09 met three improvement targets but exceeded the CYP3A4 limit (Table 7 ).

paragraphs.en: After the second-batch predictions returned, DrugHarness generated ten further structures from the same reference. B3-02, the submitted candidate, met all four improvement targets and all four holding conditions. Its CYP3A4 prediction was 0.8079, compared with B2-09’s 0.9311; its BBB, hERG and AMES predictions were higher but remained within their limits (Figure 6 ). Molecules from the generated SDF were registered as shared candidate records, allowing ADMET, structural comparison, and binding prediction to address the same molecule. For B3-02, RDKit computed a reference similarity of 0.7692, above the required 0.70; Boltz-2 returned a binding-probability prediction of 0.9944, above 0.70. DrugHarness then wrote and read back solution.smi , submitting the same molecular state used in the prediction (Figure 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 第二批预测结果返回后，DrugHarness 基于相同的参考生成了另外十种结构。 已提交的候选化合物 B3-02 满足了全部四个改进目标和四个保留条件。 其 CYP3A4 预测值为 0.8079，低于 B2-09 的 0.9311；其 BBB、hERG 和 AMES 预测值更高，但仍处于各自限制范围内（图 6）。 从生成的 SDF 中提取的分子被注册为共享候选记录，从而使得 ADMET、结构比较和结合预测能够针对同一分子进行分析。 对于 B3-02，RDKit 计算出的参考相似性为 0.7692，高于所需的 0.70；Boltz-2 返回的结合概率预测值为 0.9944，高于 0.70。 随后，DrugHarness 编写并重新读取了 solution.smi，提交了预测中使用的相同分子状态（图 5）。

paragraphs.en: Given a source SMILES, this MolBench task asks for an increase in the quantitative estimate of drug-likeness (QED) through intermediate optimization steps. QED improvement is the evaluation criterion, with no target-activity preservation constraint; the final SMILES is submitted in JSON.
paragraphs.zh: 给定一个源 SMILES，这个 MolBench 任务要求通过中间优化步骤来提高药物相似性（QED）的定量估计值。 QED 的提升是评估标准，且没有保留目标活性的约束；最终的 SMILES 以 JSON 格式提交。

paragraphs.en: Starting from a molecule with recorded QED 0.4982, DrugHarness generated and evaluated three candidate batches using Python/RDKit within the same task. The first batch yielded a leading candidate with QED 0.9285. The next script used that exact evaluated structure as its baseline to construct further variants. The second batch yielded an N-methyl-amide candidate with QED 0.9375, which the third script likewise used as its baseline before exploring additional substitutions.
paragraphs.zh: 从一个记录有 QED 值为 0.4982 的分子出发，DrugHarness 在同一任务中使用 Python/RDKit 生成并评估了三个候选批次。 第一个批次产生了一个 QED 值为 0.9285 的领先候选分子。 下一个脚本将刚刚评估出的该结构直接用作基准，以构建更多变体。 第二个批次产生了一个 QED 值为 0.9375 的 N-甲基酰胺候选分子，第三个脚本同样将其用作基准，随后探索了其他取代方式。
